description_en: Queries created letters of authorization. You can view the review status and authorized signature scope of the letters
description_zh: 查询已创建的授权委托书，可查看授权书审核状态、授权签名范围
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi query-sms-authorization-letter --authorization-letter-id-list 1000000000 --sign-name '菜鸟网络' --organization-code 90000000000000000A --state PASSED --status VALID --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySmsAuthorizationLetter

parameters.help_en: The list of letter of authorization IDs
parameters.name: authorization_letter_id_list

parameters.help_en: The signature name. If the authorization scope includes multiple signatures when you create the letter of authorization, the letters of authorization that contain the signature are returned
parameters.help_zh: 签名名称。若您创建授权书时，授权范围包括多个签名，则会返回包含该签名的授权书
parameters.name: sign_name

parameters.help_en: The unified social credit code of the authorizing party. The length cannot exceed 150 characters
parameters.help_zh: 委托授权方社会统一信用代码，长度不超过150个字符
parameters.name: organization_code

parameters.help_en:
The review status of the letter of authorization, which is related to the review status of the signature. Valid values:
INT: Pending review. The letter of authorization has been created. After you submit a signature application, it enters the review process.
PASSED: Review passed. When a signature in the authorized signature scope of the letter of authorization passes the review, the status of the letter of authorization changes to PASSED
parameters.help_zh:
委托授权书审核状态，与签名审核状态相关，取值：
INT：待审核。委托授权书已创建，当您提交签名申请后进入审核流程。
PASSED：审核通过。当您的委托授权签名范围中有签名审核通过时，委托授权书状态变为PASSED
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The availability status of the letter of authorization, which is related to the validity period of the letter of authorization. Valid values:

VALID: Available. The letter of authorization is within the validity period.
INVALID: Unavailable. The letter of authorization has expired
parameters.help_zh:
委托授权书可用状态，与授权书有效期相关，取值：

VALID：可用，授权书处于有效期内。
INVALID：不可用，授权书已过期
parameters.name: status

State.description_en:

PASSED: Review passed. When a signature in the authorized signature scope of the letter of authorization passes the review, the status of the letter of authorization changes to PASSED
State.description_zh:

INT：待审核。委托授权书已创建，当您提交签名申请后进入审核流程。
PASSED：审核通过。当您的委托授权签名范围中有签名审核通过时，委托授权书状态变为PASSED

State.title_zh: 委托授权书审核状态（初始化INT/审核通过PASSED）
